facts.fact: Lesotho's Bureau of Statistics says it conducted a workshop on modernizing administrative data for official statistics, financed and supported by the Economic Commission for Africa.
The Bureau of Statistics lists pre-2026 population and housing census activities done with UNFPA support: a project document developed and GIS software procured.

LSO.note: Lists domestic and international private finance only as funding mechanisms, with no amount.
Says only that the 2001 Statistics Act was reviewed and instructions drafted for the Parliamentary Counsel; no draft bill or force stated.

facts.fact: The Bureau of Statistics presents NSDS II for 2022-2026/27, with a funding strategy of 2022.
